title: Falsification Lab · Two capacities, no easy claims
summary: An original offline packing lab with a pre-comparison protocol commit, six methods, all four synthetic scenarios and 504 verified assignments. Beam search saves 23 modeled bins across 80 paired cases; best-fit's regression, exact-search skips and all counterexamples remain inspectable.
limitations: All inputs and improvements are synthetic two-capacity scalar results, not actual packing, mass, geometry, handling or safety evidence.
The local protocol was committed before new candidate execution but after review of known reference outcomes; it is not blinded or externally registered.
The original JS PRNG preserves seed 1729 and 20 paired repetitions but does not reproduce unexecuted Python random arrays.
Beam search retains at most 128 states; exact search stops above 12 items or at 50000 nodes. Skipped and unclosed results remain explicitly unknown.
Four authored scenarios do not establish universal superiority, population effects, novelty, patentability, market demand or financial savings.
Fresh-process repetition and Node DOM tests are not independent human replication, actual browser visual review, physical testing or operator validation.
Native Hive initialization, human review, services, publication, outreach, spending and external mutations were not performed.
